I'm checking the critique that the main specification only uses post-treatment outcomes and should control for or difference out the baseline. The Figure 3 notes say the estimates come from OLS on equation (1) with the full set of pre-treatment controls from Table A-3, and Table 1 column 5 includes the baseline outcome along with the imbalanced variables and full controls. Now I'm pulling the reported effect sizes from the text: 6.5% for SD valuation and 6.8% for the state measure.

The critique's core claim, that the main specification only uses post-treatment outcomes, doesn't hold up: column 5 of Table 1 already controls for the baseline outcome alongside the imbalanced variables. Since ANCOVA with a baseline control is generally more efficient than change scores, the critique is mostly wrong, and the one open question is whether the valuation measure was identically captured at baseline. Even so, that doesn't change the conclusion, so I'd rate the issue as one that does not matter.
